summary: Published OSS releases now wake the fixed cloud staging/demo reconciliation path automatically.
configuration: RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN must retain permission to create repository dispatch events in EnterpriseGlue/enterpriseglue-cloud.
security: The receiver independently resolves authoritative release and candidate identities; event payload fields do not select deployment inputs.
documentation: Documents the release wake-up, manual replay, and scheduled staging reconciliation behavior.
knownLimitations: A missing cross-repository token delays immediate wake-up until the Cloud repository's scheduled reconciliation.
rollback: Remove the staging reconciliation step from release-notify.yml; this does not change published release artifacts.
validation: Release readiness and release-note contract suites verify the exact release, tag dereference, token, destination repository, and event type.
